t: I Tried Tom Cruise's Deadliest Stunt
d: Michelle Khare attempts to become the second person after Tom Cruise to perform the famous plane hang from Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation.

t: I Tried Learning A Backflip in 24 Hours
d: Michelle trains with elite gymnasts, cheerleaders, and stunt performers to try and learn to backflip in only 24 hours.
Michelle trains with an emergency call center to experience the mental and emotional demands of being a 911 dispatcher.
Michelle spends a week training at the San Diego Police Academy.
Michelle trains with real homicide detectives, crime scene analysts, and forensic experts to investigate a simulated murder case.

t: I Tried A Nuclear War Simulation
d: Michelle plays the role of Madam President in a high-stakes nuclear war simulation—where she has just 8 minutes to decide the fate of the world.
Michelle confronts her lifelong fear of childbirth by training with professional doctors and OB-GYNs to learn how to deliver a baby.

t: I Trained Like An NFL Player
d: Michelle spends a week with an NFL coach, learning to throw, tackle, and run routes.

Michelle dives into a high-pressure, two-day crash course in professional paintball, learning to shoot, move, and strategize alongside elite athletes, all in preparation for a competitive 3v3 tournament match.
Michelle joins a traveling circus and learns how to perform iconic circus acts in front of a live crowd.

t: I Joined The #1 Cheer Team In America
d: Michelle chases a childhood dream by trying out for the University of Kentucky's top cheerleading team. With only 10 days to train, she takes on tough tumbling, stunts, and dance challenges, to see if she can make the cut.

t: I Competed In A Beauty Pageant For The First Time
d: Michelle experiences a 60-day intensive pageant training program with a professional pageant coach, focusing on fitness, interview techniques, and stage presence, to prepare for a Miss USA competition.
Michelle reflects on her pageant journey, answers viewer questions, and shares honest insights about confidence, self-image, and the world of beauty competitions.

t: I Trained Like A Victoria's Secret Model for 5 Weeks
d: Michelle follows the rigorous diet and workouts of Victoria's Secret models to uncover what it really takes to build and maintain the body of a professional swimsuit model.
